assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: individual transparent food selection sticker for the Super Nutrition mobile app.
Primary request: one ripe red tomato with a small green calyx, plus one clean tomato half showing seeds.
Style/medium: crisp photorealistic product photograph with natural food texture and gentle studio light; match the small realistic food stickers already used in the app. Add a clean thin white die-cut outline tracing the complete combined silhouette.
Composition/framing: a single compact food group centered on a square transparent canvas; entire subject visible with around 10% even padding. The recognizable food must read clearly at a tiny mobile icon size. Food fills around 75-80% of image.
Color palette: true natural food colors, neutral white lighting.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background; only the described food and any indispensable simple clear vessel; white outline only around the silhouette; no table, plate, other food, decorative herbs, sauces or garnish. No green backing, shadows outside the silhouette, text, labels, brand, watermark, anthropomorphic face, checkmark, badge, UI or sticker sheet.
